title: Deploy to Server
command:
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@192.168.0.29 -p 10000 << 'DEPLOYEOF'
cd /data/docker/playwright-user-sys/docker

# 等待之前的 pull 完成（可能还在进行）
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml pull 2>&1

# 重启服务
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d 2>&1

# 等待容器启动
sleep 15

# 检查容器状态
echo "=== Container Status ==="
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps 2>&1

# 检查健康状态
echo "=== Health Check ==="
for i in 1 2 3; do
  sleep 5
  docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps --format "table {{.Name}}\t{{.Status}}" 2>&1
done

# 冒烟测试
echo "=== Smoke Tests ==="
echo "Admin Login Page: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3011/admin/login)"
echo "Sessions API: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3011/api/sessions)"

# CORS 检查
echo "=== Security Verification ==="
echo "CORS headers:"
curl -s -I -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' http://localhost:3011/api/sessions 2>&1 | grep -i 'access-control' || echo "(no CORS headers - production secure)"

echo "Manager logs (last 20 lines):"
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs manager --tail=20 2>&1
DEPLOYEOF

title: Deploy to production server
command:
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@192.168.0.29 -p 10000 << 'EOF'
cd /data/docker/playwright-user-sys/docker

echo "=== Pulling images ==="
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml pull 2>&1

echo "=== Restarting ==="
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d 2>&1

sleep 15

echo "=== Status ==="
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps 2>&1

echo "=== Health check (3 rounds) ==="
for i in 1 2 3; do
  sleep 10
  docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps 2>&1
done
EOF
